story_title: Five bedrooms, one pool, the heart of Seminyak.
story_lead: A private estate built for families and groups: staff on site, a chef on call, and Seminyak's beach clubs and restaurants within a five-minute walk.
story_points: 5 ensuite bedrooms, master with ocean terrace
20 m private pool, sun deck and garden pavilion
Full-time staff, daily housekeeping, private chef on request
5 minutes on foot to Seminyak beach and Eat Street
book_lead: Rates include staff, daily housekeeping, welcome dinner and airport transfers. Minimum three nights; five over Christmas and New Year.
gap_source: Source: PriceLabs neighbourhood data, Seminyak, 4–10 bedroom villas (350 listings), pulled September 2026: low season February, March and pre-Christmas December; market occupancy for large villas peaks at 33–49% even in the busiest weeks.
cta_title: A site like this, live in 48 hours — and the low season filled.
cta_text: Fifteen minutes on WhatsApp to walk through the numbers for your villa. We are opening Bali low season with a handful of villa partners.
